text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука emerges victorious from
the race.
Disappointed by her loss, Air
Groove challenges
Сайленс Судзука to
another race in the future,
where she
vows to restore her pride.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука recognizes the
passionate drive
within Эйр Грув, and
the two shake hands to
seal the new
challenge.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Witnessing Сайленс Судзука's performance
in the
Takarazuka Kinen inspires both El
Condor Pasa
and Грасс Вандер to step
up their game as well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As summer camp approaches, Silence
Suzuka
prepares herself for an all-new
challenge.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
